player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id}. Udlala umdlalo we Guess The Number. Kumele uqagele inombolo ephakathi kuka {min_number} no {max_number} ngaphakathi kwama-{max_turns} turns. Njengoba ufaka ukuqagela kwakho, umdlalo uzokunikeza izinkomba ezifana 'ngaphezulu' noma 'ngezansi'. Unganikeza impendulo yakho nganoma iyiphi indlela. Inombolo kuphela esongwe kubakaki besikwele izobhekwa njengokuqagela kwakho. Isibonelo, [5]. Njengoba udlala, umlando wokuqagela kwakho uzofakwa ngezansi. Sebenzisa imininingwane ukuqedela umdlalo ngaphambi kokuthi uphelelwe ukuqagela. Faka ukuqagela kwakho.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokunyakaza engalungile. Umdlali {player_id} akaphendulanga nge-'[number] 'evumelekile.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ukudlala okungavumelekile. Umdlali {player_id} uqagele inombolo engaphandle kwebanga elichaziwe.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Ukudlala okungavumelekile. Umdlali {player_id} usevele uqagele inombolo.
